title: Lift, Splat, Shoot: Encoding Images From Arbitrary Camera Rigs by Implicitly Unprojecting to 3D
grouping: No boxes or containers: four drawn stages in one row joined by short black arrows, each named by a plain caption underneath ('Per-Image CNN + Lift', 'Extrinsics + Splat', 'Bird's-Eye-View CNN').
shapes_depth: Input is a deck of camera photos offset diagonally with faint grey arrows behind it; the per-image network is a white wireframe frustum prism with 'xN' inside. The splat stage is a top-view yellow car icon ringed by six camera photos, each covered by a translucent blue triangular frustum fanning out from the car. The output is a stack of offset white square maps carrying sparse coloured segmentation strokes. Flat, thin black outlines, sans-serif captions.
proposed_highlight: Nothing is singled out; the contribution is carried by the middle illustration, the largest element, where the camera rig geometry (ego car, ring of views, blue frustums) stands in for a 'view transform' box.
lesson: Show the camera-to-BEV step as a top-view ego car ringed by its camera images, each under a translucent blue frustum fanning out from the car, so the rig geometry itself is the transform stage rather than a labelled box.
notes: Venue ECCV 2020 from the arXiv comment (venue_source: arxiv-journal-ref); year = that venue year. Element 'other' = the wireframe frustum prism standing for the per-image network. The whole figure is a single raster image in the PDF (refs crop recorded one embedded image covering the crop), so kb measure cannot separate photos from drawing: photo_share is null and the palette includes the embedded photos and renders.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
